content.json:
# Microsoft 365 Copilot Governance Overview

Microsoft Sentinel provides correlation, visualization, investigation routing, and operational health. Microsoft Purview, Defender, Entra, Microsoft 365 reporting, and Global Secure Access remain authoritative. Missing Sentinel data does not mean that no risk or compliance activity exists.

content.query:
M365Gov_DataHealth(24h)
| summarize Sources=count(), Healthy=countif(Status == "Healthy"), Stale=countif(Status == "Stale"), UnavailableOrSilent=countif(Status == "UnavailableOrSilent")
content.title: Native source coverage and health

content.query:
M365Gov_DataHealth(24h)
| project TableName, Status, LastEventTime, ExpectedFreshness, AuthoritativeControlOwner, NativePortalRoute, RequiredForMvp
| order by RequiredForMvp desc, Status asc, TableName asc
content.title: Control ownership and native routing

content.json:
# Native Alert Correlation

This view displays existing native alerts and cross-product context. Resolve detections in the authoritative Microsoft portal. Sentinel does not reproduce Purview, Defender, or Entra detection logic.

> **Identity privacy:** Raw actor identifiers are sensitive. Limit access to personnel with a need to know, and use masked or pseudonymized reporting views when direct identity is not necessary.

content.query:
M365Gov_NativeAlerts(ago(24h), now())
| summarize AlertCount=count(), Products=dcount(ProductName), Providers=dcount(ProviderName) by ActorIdentifier
| where isnotempty(ActorIdentifier)
| order by AlertCount desc
content.title: Entities represented by native alerts

content.query:
M365Gov_NativeAlerts(ago(24h), now())
| project TimeGenerated, AlertName, AlertSeverity, AlertStatus, ActorIdentifier, ProductName, ProviderName, AuthoritativeControlOwner, NativePortalRoute
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Native alert investigation routing

content.json:
# Governance Data Health

This view reports ingestion freshness and silence. `UnavailableOrSilent` can mean absent, unlicensed, unauthorized, disabled, or simply no events. Validate each source in its native portal and connector configuration.

content.query:
M365Gov_DataHealth(24h)
| project TableName, Status, LastEventTime, Age, EventCount, ExpectedFreshness, RequiredForMvp, AuthoritativeControlOwner, NativePortalRoute
| order by RequiredForMvp desc, Status asc, TableName asc
content.title: Freshness and remediation routing

content.json:
# Coverage and Gaps

This view distinguishes required MVP sources from optional or preview coverage. Native services remain authoritative even when their telemetry is unavailable in Sentinel. Optional custom interaction and usage integrations are not part of the default MVP.

content.query:
M365Gov_DataHealth(24h)
| extend CoverageClass=iff(RequiredForMvp, "MVP", "Optional or conditional")
| summarize Sources=count(), Healthy=countif(Status == "Healthy"), Gaps=countif(Status != "Healthy") by CoverageClass
content.title: MVP and optional coverage

content.query:
M365Gov_DataHealth(24h)
| where Status != "Healthy"
| extend CoverageClass=iff(RequiredForMvp, "MVP", "Optional or conditional")
| project CoverageClass, TableName, Status, LastEventTime, ExpectedFreshness, AuthoritativeControlOwner, NativePortalRoute
| order by CoverageClass asc, TableName asc
content.title: Documented gaps and native owners

content.json:
# Copilot interaction content

Prompt and response text exported by the opt-in collector from the Microsoft Graph interaction export API into `M365GovCopilotInteractionContent_CL` (90-day retention). This tab is empty when collection was deployed as **Disabled**. Everyone who can open this workbook and read the workspace can read this content; use it only under your organization's approved investigation process. Search here is manual lookup, not classification.

content.query:
let interactions = union isfuzzy=true
    (datatable(TimeGenerated: datetime, InteractionId: string, SessionId: string, RequestId: string, InteractionType: string, AppClass: string, UserPrincipalName: string, BodyContent: string, BodyTruncated: bool, CollectorRunId: string)[]),
    (M365GovCopilotInteractionContent_CL)
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by InteractionId;
interactions
| summarize Interactions=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), AppClass
content.title: Collected interactions by app

content.query:
let interactions = union isfuzzy=true
    (datatable(TimeGenerated: datetime, InteractionId: string, SessionId: string, RequestId: string, InteractionType: string, AppClass: string, UserPrincipalName: string, BodyContent: string, BodyTruncated: bool, CollectorRunId: string)[]),
    (M365GovCopilotInteractionContent_CL)
    | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by InteractionId;
interactions
| summarize Interactions=count(), Users=dcount(UserPrincipalName), LastInteraction=max(TimeGenerated) by CollectorRunId
| order by LastInteraction desc
| take 25
content.title: Collector runs
Prompts and responses
